description: Your registered webhooks for your tenant identity (your paying wallet, or your key id), optionally narrowed to one id. Without secret each webhook shows id, active and expiry only. With the signing secret from registration, that webhook also shows its url, events, chains and watches. Never returns the secret

id.description: Webhook id from registration, 8 hex characters. Example: 3f9a0c1b

secret.description: Signing value from registration, 32 hex characters. Example: 00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff

tenant.description: Tenant identity: the paying wallet address in lower case, or the numeric key id of a ChainHelix subscription. Example: 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead

name: webhook_status
